name: 64-robust-error-play-retries
description: Robustness: segment 3 fails five times (retries after 2, 4, 8, 16, 30 s) and the playhead runs dry at the end of 2 (Error). At about 16 s the render becomes available and the listener presses play: the player should ask for 3 again then and resume within a few seconds, not sit in Error until the 30 s backoff ends.
